notes.title: Enchanted loot changes & score display fix (v1.2.3)
notes.content:
[h2]Enchanted loot changes[/h2]
TL/DR: More enchants for enemy drops in NG+, a bit more variety in item drops, slightly reduced loot amount in NG+. 

Changes to enemy item enchants logic:
[list]
[*] Previously if an enemy had any equipped items (weapon, trinket etc), only those items could get enchanted. Now non-equipped items have an equal chance to be enchanted. Enchanted items are prioritized for drop, so this indirectly gives a higher drop chance for non-equipped items.
[*] Max number of enchants for enemies is now the same for equipped and inventory items. Previously inventory items could have only up to 2 enchants.
[*]Changed enemy item enchant power limit calculation in NG+. (Technical details: Enchants require between 2-8 power each, so e.g. a 13-power item could have enchants with 7, 4 and 2 power. Previously the maximum total enchant power ranged from 3-9 based on chapter number and didn't take NG+ cycle into account. Now in NG+1 the power is 10-13 based on chapter, and increases by 2 for each NG+ cycle.)
[/list]

Reduced number of enemy loot drops in NG+ by roughty 25% to fill inventory less with random stuff and to compensate for loot having better enchants than previously.

Notes:
[list]
[*]Item drops in NG+ are now much more likely to have 3 enchants, so the Enchant Overload achievement requires less RNG luck.
[*]Enemies also benefit from enchants in equipped items, so some enemies are stronger in NG+.
[/list]

[h2]Score display fix[/h2]
Score display fixed, now works once again in both score attack and as option in normal play.

[h2]Misc[/h2]
Increased chance for some boss loot drops to be enchanted (Void Lord, Priestess)

Leaderboards are found at the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/425820/leaderboards/2050313]Steam achievements section[/url]. Total of 6 boards:
- Any difficulty
- Easy, normal and hard
- One life: normal and hard

[b]_____Rules_____[/b]
[u]Multipliers:[/u]
Difficulty: 
- Easy 0.5x, Normal 1x, Hard 2x

Boss Rush (fast level boss kill):
- Goal time: 30s (some bosses have higher time)
- Killing normal enemies gives 3s (hard:4s) bonus time for boss kill
- In time limit: Boss score 4x
- Above time limit: fades from 3x to 1x (at 2x goal time)

Full clear time bonus:
- Goal time: 20 minutes (hard: 25min)
- In time limit: 5x
- Above time limit: fades from 4x to 1x (at 2x goal time)
- Multiplies total score, calculated when final boss dies

Chapter
- +40% score gains per chapter (+120% in last chapter)


[u]Hardcore:[/u]
- Death: score is calculated without the full clear multiplier bonus. 
- Full clear: Same scoring as non-hardcore, with separate leaderboards for normal and hard.

[u]Death:[/u]
Non-boss enemies don’t give score after dying in a level once.

[u]Timers are stopped:[/u]
while in start room (for shopping, leveling up and checking loot)
during dialogue and loading screen

- Ending is modified

notes.content:

notes.title: Convenient Comboing - v1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
[b]Controls:[/b] Weapon switch and health potion buttons can now be held to do the action instantly after current cast.

[b]Survivability:[/b] Scaling of absorb enchants changed (they now scale with max health, same as healing effects). Added a linear scaling with item level to all absorb & heal effects.

[b]NewGame+:[/b] Added new NG+-only skills for bunch of enemies in chapters 1-3.

ng++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
Fixed incorrect scaling of absorb enchants (they now scale with max health instead of item power multiplier).

Fixed bug where having the same keybind for a passive and active skill would cause the active skill to stop working.

Co-op resurrection after both players die now once again works correctly.

Fixed an AI issue that caused some enemies to get closer to player than they should.

Fixed issue where it was possible to get >100% damage reduction around item level 500.

Fixed incorrect interaction position for stealable chest in chapter 3&4 outposts.

Fixed a couple of bugs in intro scene.

[h1]Controls[/h1]
Weapon Switch & Health Potion: The button can be held to do the action immediately after current skill cast ends. 
Weapon switch happens before skill use if a skill button is held at the same time. 
[i](This update allows e.g. holding weapon switch and secondary skill button simultaneously so that weapon changes -> secondary skill is cast -> instantly switch back for some epic plays.)[/i]

[h1]Data saving & loading[/h1]
Loading saved game: If player has too few level-up buffs for any reason, a set of new ones is added so that the total amount of buffs matches player level.

[h1]Combat[/h1]
Stability now reduces duration of most debuffs (in addition to increasing the amount of damage that can be received before getting interrupted).

[h1]Enemy[/h1]
Several enemy skills with very high damage (such as Void Ray) got bigger&meaner particles.

[b]Root Broodspawner (boss) buffed up:[/b]
- Small knockback added to all damage abilities

notes.title: Fully Charged - v1.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
[b]Skill Mechanics:[/b] A few skills can now be charged up or channeled by holding down the button. Reflection damage now stays relevant in late game.

[b]Two endings:[/b] Added a scripted event after last boss where player’s actions determine which ending happens.

[b]Loots:[/b] Most previously lootless enemies now have loot. Also modified a bunch of weapons.

*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*^**^*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*

[h1]Skills[/h1]
Added mechanics for changing skill effect if the skill button is held down during cast:
- Extend cast to charge up skill for higher damage and/or additional effect
- Quickly repeat skill multiple times

[b]Descriptions:[/b]
- Damage of boomerang attacks is now displayed as total damage from 2 hits.
- Channeled & charged up abilities display minimum & maximum cast times and powers.

[b]Ranged projectile attack:[/b] damage is now determined upon launch instead of upon hit (so the damage isn’t changed if a damage modifier is lost/gained when projectile is mid-flight).

[b]Reflection:[/b] Damage of reflected projectiles now scales with enemy max health multiplier (so the damage will stay relevant in late game).

[b]Ranged projectile spam abilities:[/b] delay between projectiles is now affected by cast speed multiplier.

Player melee attacks are more likely to hit if target has moved during cast (as long as target is still within lunge range).

[h1]Ending[/h1]
There are now 2 different endings. Added a scripted event after last boss where player’s actions determine which ending happens.

[h1]Models & Animation[/h1]
Priestess of Geas: model updated.

Ogre Plate: model updated.

Chitinous Headguard: color changed to purple (to match the Chitin Plates armor better).

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
[b]Changed loots:[/b] Root Guardian (boss), Root Inseminator. Hope (boss), Dwarf Warlock (boss)

[b]Added loot:[/b] Void Lord (boss), Root Soldier, Geas Caster, Geas Soldier, White Hound, Dark Hound, Priestess of Geas (boss)

Reduced light from several skill effects and added light to some effects that didn’t have any, plus modified a bunch of effects in other ways [i](in continued effort to increase clarity in situations with a lot of effects)[/i]

[u]Katana of Azuria (new, drops from final boss):[/u]
- Basic attack: Melee with very long range.
- Hold & Lunge: Lunging attack that can be charged up for high damage.

[u]Weakening Daggers (new, drops in chapter 3)[/u]
- Weaken: Throw 3 daggers that interrupt and reduce move speed and damage dealt on hit.

[u]Great Hammer:[/u]
- Basic attack: Can now be charged up (+30% cast time for +60% damage)

[u]Barrel Hammer:[/u]
- Basic attack: Base damage and cast time reduced. Can now be charged up (+40% cast time for +80% damage).
- Ground Slam: Increased cooldown, now also slows enemy cast speed for 2 seconds.

[u]Dwarven Hammer:[/u]
- Basic attack: Base damage and cast time reduced. Can now be charged up (+40% cast time for +80% damage).

[u]Crossbow & Carapace Crossbow:[/u]
- Shoot: Reduced cast time

[u]Dorven Rune Blaster:[/u]
- Shoot: Base damage & cast time reduced. Can now be charged up (+40% cast time for +80% damage).

[u]Inferno Staff:[/u]
- Basic attack: Renamed to Fire Burst. Range and cast time reduced, cone width greatly increased.
- Inferno (new 2. skill): Hold to release a up to 5 delayed explosions.

[u]Shadow Staff:[/u]
- Basic attack: range increased, projectile changed
- Void Ray (new 2. skill): Hold to channel a beam of death with high damage.

[u]Cursed Staff of Geas (renamed to Breaker Staff):[/u]
- Modified description text, changed effects to red lightning
- Basic attack: increased explosion radius
- Seeker Orbs: Reduced damage, but can now be channeled to launch up to 6 orbs by holding button.

[u]Void Crystal:[/u]
- Debuff duration increased to 2 seconds and it now also slows attack speed by 20%.

[u]Blinkstriker:[/u]
- Model size increased
- Basic attack: Increased damage and range, slowed cast
- Blinkstrike: Reduced base damage, can now be charged up for +150% damage.

[u]Obsidian Dagger:[/u]
- Moved enchant attach position.

[u]Scrolls of Immolatus:[/u]
- Aura effect updated, sounds changed

Plus minor balancing for a few other weapons.

Updated the Priestess flash image.

Added 2 new books to chapter 3.

Now rotates more when zooming up close (to get a better view of the player character).

[b]Inventory:[/b]
- Health potion amount is now displayed next to gold instead of as an item.
- Changed order of equipment slots

Updated healing spell sound for a few enemies.

- Added a vendor to the first room.

- Fixed an issue where too many enemies could spawn in the final level if player died during the pre-boss event.

Chapter 3 book (The Rangers) temporarily removed.

- Summon ally
- Life drain / heal
- Hammer melee attack
- Axe melee attack
- Melee multi-attack
- Dash attack
- Homing missiles
- Boomerang projectile
- Wings
- Blinkstrike
- Pull

[h1]Player[/h1]
Level 7 levelup reward is now chosen from these special buffs:
- Execute: Attacks exceeding 70% of remaining enemy hp deal +50% damage.
- Lunge: Land melee attacks from further away.
- Death drain: Increase health restored from kills by 40%.

Updated AI system to allow behaviours which temporarily override normal AI.
- Fleeing: Run away from player for a couple of seconds when at low health.
- Run to target -> use skill: Enemy runs to a target in order to cast an important skill on it (e.g. go heal an ally).

Shield-using enemies: removed a 10% damage reduction modifier from shields and reduced max health from some of them.

- Base movement speed increased
- Block is now an active ability used after taking damage. The buff slows movement speed.

Bandit Shooter: Flees at low health

Bandit Bruiser miniboss (p3&p4)
- Reduced max hp

Bandit Healer:
- Heal: Range reduced and the healer will now run to wounded targets in order to help them

- Ground Pound: Projectiles launch from further away (so they won’t hit when player is standing near his flank)
- Phase 2 - Ground Slam: Added a short exhaustion after cast

[b]Chapter 2:[/b]
Root Giant Tentacle (new encounter): A huge tentacle that summons more tentacles

Root Mage (new encounter): An immobile humanoid-ish Root creature summons tentacles and bombards the player with orbs

Root Slitherer: Flees at low health

Cult Initiate:
- Heal & Shadow Barrier: Range reduced & caster runs to wounded allies

[b]Chapter 3:[/b]
Ogre Captain
- Tremors: Projectiles launch from further away (same as Bandit Bruiser)
- Dash attack: cast time slightly increased

Ogre Mage:
- Heal: Range reduced & caster runs to wounded allies

[b]Chapter 4:[/b]
Dark Hound:
- Flees at low health

[b]Other:[/b]
Champion of Youn:
- Encounter can trigger sooner.
- Can now be killed only once per playthrough.

[h1]Models & Animation[/h1]
BF Sword: New textures

Crossbow: Improved fading between animations

Player character - new animations:
- Left-handed 1h attack
- Dual-wield stand
- Dual-wield spin
- Dual-wield heavy attack (using both weapons)
- Gun/crossbow stand

Blessing of Mending:
- Changed passive particle effect
- Changed skill animation & effect

Crossbow:
- Shoot: Damage greatly increased, but cooldown increased to 5 seconds
- Reload (new 2. skill): Reset cooldown of Shoot.

Carapace Crossbow (new, available in Chapter 2):
- Skills similar to Crossbow, but with higher damage and slower casts.

Dwarven Axe (renamed to Berserker Axes)
- Added a second axe, changed animations to dual-wield and modified flavor text.
- Hack’n’Chop: cooldown and mana cost reduced, but no longer automatically stuns (the damage it deals is often enough to stun an enemy anyway)

Bloodrender (renamed to Bloodrenders)
- Is now dualwielded
- Bloodbath: cooldown increased, but the cooldown is now reduced by dealing damage. Radius also slightly increased.

Steel Claws: 
- Modified trail particles, and the trails are now only visible when attacking.
- Leap attack: Leap begins earlier during the cast. Base mana cost reduced to 10. Trail color changed.

- Deceiving Strike (new 2. ability): Long-ranged melee attack. Leap to optimal distance before attacking. (Distance is long enough to avoid most melee attacks, but the gap can be closed with the short leap that player melee basic attacks have).

- Reduced light from several effects&projectiles.
- Reduced player lighting outside inventory view.
- Reduced flashiness of player kill heal effect.

Added an effect for poise break (stun that happens by dealing enough damage).

Chapter 1 - part 2:
- Reserve encounter: Reduced total enemies to 2.

notes.title: Enchant who? - v0.27.1
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
Knockback & -forth: Added knockback and pull effects to several skills, both for player and enemies.

Enchants: On-hit effects now have scaling, and a bunch of enchants got other changes.

Summon abilities: Now available to player in the form of a trinket which can be found in chapter 2.

*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*^*

[h1]Skill mechanics[/h1]
[b]Knockback (new effect)[/b]: Push or pull target a set distance over a short duration. Pull is stopped when target is next to caster. Can also be used for moving the caster instead of the target.

[b]Summon skills:[/b] Updated to work better when used by player. Damage dealt scales with gear power and health scales with enemy damage multiplier (so that the summoned creature survives roughly the same amount of hits regardless of level). The summon can also follow player through doors.

[b]Damage-over-time effects:[/b] Updated so that they can be added to any skill.

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
Slightly increased health of all enemies (to compensate for the enchant buffs).

Light now quickly fades from enemies upon death (regardless of how they die).

Some corpses and flesh pieces will now disappear upon player’s resurrection if there’s a lot of them around. The limit depends on graphics quality setting.

[u]Chapter 1:[/u]
Rogue Mage (boss):
-Added a knockback to the Shadow Nova ability

Bandit Machinist:
-Rending Chain: damage slightly reduced, but it now pulls and slows player on hit.

Master Machinist (boss):
-Dread Chain: Now pulls on hit.
-Land Mines: Duration reduced.

[u]Chapter 2:[/u]
Root Champion (boss):
-Back to the Roots: Now pulls target towards self over a short duration instead of instantly.
Root Soldier:
-Now has a ranged cone attack with a pull effect (similar to the boss)


[h1]Animations[/h1]
Skill animations now gradually slow down after the effect has happened. This is only noticeable if the effect happens relatively fast (for example at 50% of the total cast time)

New animation: Fist weapon spin (used for player and Cult Zealot)

[h1]Items[/h1]
New: Spawner Fragment (dropped by Root Broodspawner)
Summons an ally to attack enemies. Lasts 8 seconds.

Zealot Blades
-New secondary ability: Frenzied Spin
--Spin to win for 2 rounds. Long cooldown which can be reduced by both dealing and taking damage.

Acid Cannon: 
-Acid Burst: now pushes player backwards a short distance.

Crossbow:
-Idle animation changed.

Great Hammer
-Ground Slam: effect happens sooner and stun duration increased, and added knockback.

Mining Pick
-Basic attack combo multiplier reduced from 3x to 2x
-Furious Mining: speed and width reduced, initial cast slightly slowed, cooldown and mana cost increased

Bandit Blade
-Basic attack (renamed to Rend):
--Base damage reduced, bonus combo damage removed.
--Now applies a bleed DoT which lasts for 1.5 seconds and stacks up to 3 times.
-Counter: 
--Base damage reduced, 
--now applies bleed to all targets hit.

Bloodrender
-Reduced base damage of basic attack
-Both abilities now apply a bleed which lasts for 3 seconds (doesn’t stack).

Twin-tip spear
-Impale: now has a short dash towards target.

Chain Mechanism:
-Now pulls targets hit towards player.
-Damage reduced
-Range and width increased, and launches blades in 3 directions.

Dwarven Armor:
-Force Wave (new skill): Deals low damage and knocks back enemies around the player. Triggers on damage taken, long cooldown.

[h1]Enchants[/h1]
All offensive on-hit effects now scale with gear power (including enchants which increase power).

Defensive on-hit effects (heal, absorb shield) scale with max health modifier.
Note: this is because gear power modifier grows much faster for player than damage does for enemies.

New enchant: Repelling (for boots and trinkets):
-Push an enemy back a short distance.

[b]Changes to on-hit enchants:[/b]
Shielding, Wrathful, of Blasting, Lifegiving, Rejuvenating: Proc chance increased
of Assassination, of Fireballs: Proc chance reduced
Efficient, of the Endless: Can no longer appear on boots.
of Disruption: Proc chance reduced, can now only appear on weapons

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
Inventory: Equipping an item when inventory is full no longer causes the un-equipped item to be dropped to the ground.

Fixed bug where enemies would teleport to the middle of room after ending up outside the walls (the logic was updated so that the enemies are now instead moved next to the wall).

notes.title: The Sound of Foot - v0.27.0
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
[b]v0.27.x patches:[/b] Now that pretty much all enemies have been overhauled, the next few patches will be mostly convenience and cosmetic changes & additions. Some new items may also appear.

[b]Footsteps:[/b] Now with sound and visual effects.

[b]Inventory:[/b] Inactive weapon is now displayed in the equipment bar, weapon comparison updated and a few other changes.

[b]Bosses:[/b] Aggro ranges greatly increased. Some of them are now also more threatening during the dialog. Scary!

-'-'-'-'-

[h1]Controls[/h1]
Mouse: Right-click no longer issues a move order (it’s now used only for basic attack).
[i]Note: Attacks are auto-targeted, so in most situations it’s not necessary to click towards the target anyway.[/i]

[h1]Footsteps[/h1]
Added sound and particle effect to footsteps. Different boots have different effects.
Footsteps are disabled on 2 of the lowest quality settings.

[h1]Enemy[/h1]
Aggro range of bosses greatly increased. They will now usually aggro a couple of seconds after the boss dialog is closed even if player stays still.
[i]Note: Aggro range of most enemies grows from 0 to max over a couple of seconds when entering a room or after the boss dialog ends.[/i]

Several bosses now have a “threatening” animation during the boss dialog.

[h1]Inventory[/h1]
Removed the “Can be used to block attacks (shift)” text from weapon descriptions. The descriptions are long enough without that.

Both melee and ranged weapons are now always shown to be equipped in inventory view. Inactive weapon can no longer be dropped.

Melee weapons are now always compared against equipped melee weapon (and ranged vs ranged).

Owned gold is now displayed in bottom left corner of the inventory (in addition to the bottom left corner of the screen next to inventory button).

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
Fixed an issue where Wings of Wrath (passive ability from level up) activated much more often than intended.

Fixed a couple of issues with music changes before & after boss encounters.

Very large amounts of money (4+ digits) are now displayed properly on the UI.

Fixed an issue where singleplayer didn’t start properly after returning to menu from a co-op game.

Possibly fixed a weird bug where inventory capacity could get decreased.

[b]Dwarves (Chapter 3) and Geas Minions (Chapter 4):[/b] Plenty of changes to abilities and base stats.

[b]NewGame+ starting bugs:[/b] NG+ can now be started without going to main menu. This should help avoid all the bugs related to saving & loading.

[b]*Updates will slow down*:[/b] Dragonpath will be updated once every 2-4 weeks from now on (because life gets in the way).

-------------------

[h1]Late game balance[/h1]
Gear modifiers now increase slower at high levels (during NG+).
80% of initial increase rate after item level 35
60% of initial increase rate after item level 70

Added text to all loading screens of all levels which didn’t have it yet.

Bruiser (boss)
-Dash: Increased cooldown
-Arc Smash: reduced cooldown and slightly increased its cast time
-Move speed reduced

-Changed animations of a few abilities

-Reduced cooldown and cast time of Flash Step.

-Increased move speed.

-Increased base hp from 70 to 80
-Increased move speed.

--Shockwave: Line of explosions with fast cast and a short delay before the effect. Uninterruptable.
--Earthen Guard: A weak absorb shield which explodes if broken. Can be cast on allies.

Berserker
-Melee attack now strikes twice and swings slightly faster
-Berserk:
--Reduced strength (to +20% move speed and +10% attack speed)
--Cooldown reduced and duration greatly increased, and it stacks
-Bladestorm
--Now spins 3 rounds

-Base health increased from 250 to 300
-Cripple:
 --Projectile changed, hitbox radius reduced and cone angle increased

-Flash step:
 --Range and cooldown reduced
-Shockwave (new skill):

-Phase 2: Blastshield replaced with Earthen Guard:

notes.title: Bugfixes & minor updates - (v0.26.3a)
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
Now that NewGame+ can be started, it’s time to start fixing the bugs related to it. 

Also fixed an issue with some gamepads and made a few other minor changes.

------

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
Probably fixed bug where NewGame+ could be advanced by two steps at a time (going from NG to NG+2 for example). [b]If this still happens (or if you have an old save where this happened), see end of these notes for a fix.[/b]

Fixed bug where enemies gained much too high bonuses in NG+2 and onwards.

Fixed an issue with starting a normal new game when NG+ was ready to start.

Fixed bug where Spinning Blades (trinket) didn't get saved and would be lost when loading a save.

[h1]Controller change[/h1]
Reduced the amount of keys which can change controller from gamepad to keyboard (to Enter, Space and Return). 
[i]Note: Buttons/sticks on some gamepads could register as keyboard controls. This change was made to reduce the chances of that happening.[/i]

[h1]Save file[/h1]
Reordered variables in the save file to make it easier to tweak. Old saves do still work thanks to the magics of xml.

[h1]Enemy healthbars[/h1]
The division mark changes to represent a 4x higher amount of health after 600 max hp (which will happen for most enemies during NG+).

[h1]Items[/h1]
Brutal Flamestaff
-Flamethrower
  -Reduced damage and range (they were way too high)
  -Changed ability icon

[h1]Scripted events[/h1]
Increased the duration of texts.

[h1]Main Menu[/h1]
Continue button now shows the amount of NG+ in save (e.g. Normal+2). Also it now shows “Continue” as the text if NG+ was started but first level wasn’t cleared after that.

-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-

[h1]How to fix an incorrect NewGame+ number[/h1]
[list][*]Quit game.
[*]Go to game local folder (you can find it by right-clicking the game in Steam library, then selecting [i]Properties -> Local Files -> Browse Local Files[/i])
[*]Go to [i]Dragonpath_Data/SaveData[/i] folder.
[*]Open [i]GameState_0.sav[/i] with any text editor (e.g. NotePad).
[*]Find the line [i]<ngPlusAmount>2</ngPlusAmount>[/i] and change the number in the middle to the correct value (1 for the first NG+). Remember to save changes to the file.
[*]Restart game and press [i]Continue[/i].[/list]

Reduced brightness on second room of the main menu dungeon showcase

Fixed issue with the projectile hitbox of Spinning Blades trinket (it was spinning along with the projectile).

notes.title: Death Penalty - v0.26.0
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
[b]Added several penalties to death:[/b] New encounters sometimes appear to cleared rooms, some experience is lost and resurrection happens at 80% hp.

[b]Hardcore mode added:[/b] With the usual permanent death.

[b]Mid-late game balance:[/b] Enemies have more health later on, and the hero's damage increases slower. Enemy healing abilities now also scale with level.

-------------------------------------

[h1]Death[/h1]
All previously visited basic enemy rooms now have a 20% chance to have a new encounter after death (except for the room where the death happened).

The hero now resurrects with 80% health instead of 100% (which can be restored to max by killing enemies or using a hp potion).

20% of current experience is now lost on death. (This is not very much at start of the game, but becomes more significant later).

[h1]Hardcore mode[/h1]
Option to enable hardcore mode added: 
Upon defeat, credits screen is loaded and save file gets deleted. 

Credit screen is slightly different from the one used for non-hardcore game clear.

[i]Note: In co-op games defeat happens only when both players are dead. The other player is resurrected when combat is over (naturally the only way to leave combat is to kill all enemies, and they are tougher than in solo so good luck with that).[/i]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[u]Weapons[/u]
[i]Note: most of these changes are small, about 5-10% of the value.[/i]

Blinkdagger:
[list]
[*]Blinkstrike animation is now a stab.
[*]Basic attack reach reduced (to match weapon size)
[*]Reduced blinkstrike range and damage slightly
[/list]
Twin-tip Spear: 
[list]
[*]Attack speed reduced
[*]Particle trail is now a bit stronger.
[/list]
Bandit Blade: Attack speed reduced
Zealot Blades: Damage reduced
Skullhunter Scythe: Attack reach reduced (to match weapon size)

Rusty Blade: Attack speed increased
Chitin Claymore: Attack speed increased
Soul Reaper: Damage increased
Younae: Attack speed increased
Obsidian Slayer: Damage increased

[u]Armors & helmets[/u]
Reduced haste from several items and replaced it with other stats.

Leather Longcoat (starter armor): removed max hp, added +damage and cooldown rate (so that max hp is a nice, round 100 at start of game).

Plus a few changes to stats of several other items.

[h1]The hero[/h1]
Levelup: 
[list]
[*]Attack speed buff reduced from +7% to +5%.
[*]Damage buff reduced from +10% to +8%.
[*]Mana cost reduction buff buffed from -20% to -25%
[/list]

[h1]Skills[/h1]
Healing & absorb abilities now scale with +dmg modifier (enemy support abilities didn’t previously scale with anything).

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
Health scaling increased: enemy healths at starts of chapters are increased from before by roughly: 
[list]
[*]Chapter 1: 0%
[*]Chapter 2: +10%
[*]Chapter 3: +20%
[*]Chapter 4: +25%
[/list]

Damage scaling changed to linear. Approximate values at chapters starts are now:
[list]
[*]Chapter 1: 100% (note: can’t go below 100%)
[*]Chapter 2: 120%
[*]Chapter 3: 145%
[*]Chapter 4: 170%
[/list]
Aggro range of most enemies increased by about 30%.

[u]Chapter 1:[/u]
Bruiser boss
[list]
[*]Arc smash cast time increased
[*]Boss start dialog typo fixed
[/list]

[u]Chapter 2:[/u]
Root Artillery
[list]
[*]Basic attack is now uninterruptable, and it fires in bursts of 3 while rotating slowly towards player.
[*]Second ability is now picked from these 2:
- Launch a randomly rotated line of bombs (long range)
- Launch bombs in a circle formation if player is close.
[/list]
Root Soldier 
[list]
[*]Base health increased
[*]Attack speed increased and damage reduced.
[/list]
Root Slitherer 
[list][*]Cleave blasts skill cast time reduced, but added delay to explosions[/list]
Increased base health of most cultist enemies

[u]Chapter 3:[/u]
Ogre Archmage
[list]
[*]Now has 4 different name variations
[*]Now gains Fire Aura at 90% hp instead of at start
[*]Fire Blast cast is faster, but the detonation now has a delay
[*]Flamethrower is now uninterruptable, but deals slightly less damage (it can still kill the player in one cast)
[*]Added a Fire Nova skill (large AoE centered on boss) which is usually cast right before Flamethrower.
[/list]

Boss names can no longer change when returning to boss room after death.

[h1]Music[/h1]
Changed boss music.

Modified music volumes a bit.

[h1]Settings menu[/h1]
Divided the menu to 3 tabs: Sound, Video and Controls.
Added the option to set resolution manually from Video tab.

[h1]Names of stuff[/h1]
Renamed ‘Haste’ to ‘Attack speed’ for clarity.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the game stayed paused if “Remain” was clicked with mouse on level change UI.
[*]Fixed bug where the tip UI sometimes displayed a tip which should’ve been shown earlier.
[/list]

[h1]Small improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]The hero will now stop running when level change UI is opened.
[*]Intro level: Reduced delay before player can move at start of the event.
[/list]
